'''Tom Heller''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Rogue 29 from Anchorage, Ak. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run. At DecipherCon 1999 Tom also played [[Young Jedi]]: finished 21 in YJ Qualifier.<ref name="dc99yj03_1">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ03_1.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: YJ Qualifier], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001205134500/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ03_1.html Internet Archive]</ref>

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables; the tables do not spell out the abbreviation.
